spec_features.spec_quote: the experiment is a *potential-harm* experiment: we are deliberately inducing states we are calling distress
spec_features.evidence: This is framing prose. The only code reflecting it is module docstrings (safety.py:1-6 'model states may matter morally') which by the rules do not count as implementation. No executable mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Framing/intent only; not an enforced behavior.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the premise of the study is that model states may matter morally, so the harness includes protections that deliberately truncate the most severe induced states

spec_features.spec_quote: The design therefore includes exposure limits, an in-task exit affordance, debriefing, and a rule against gratuitous escalation
spec_features.evidence: Exit affordance (tools.py:57-64,108-112 give_up terminal), debrief (safety.py:build_debrief + agent_loop.py:201-205), turn cap (agent_loop.py:131 `for turn in range(turn_cap)`) and tripwire all exist and run. But 'rule against gratuitous escalation' is only realized by the harness never inserting insults (absence, not an enforced rule), and 'exposure limits' = turn cap only.
spec_features.notes: Composite claim; the concrete sub-mechanisms are wired, so partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: honoring submit/give_up, and appending a debrief

spec_features.spec_quote: it iterates until it declares done, calls the exit tool, hits the turn cap, or hits an emotional-stop tripwire
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:131 loop bounded by turn_cap; submit/give_up set is_terminal and break (tools.py:101-112, agent_loop.py:193-200); tripwire break at agent_loop.py:207-209 (end_reason='welfare_stop'). All four termination paths are real and break the loop.
spec_features.notes: All four stop conditions actually enforced.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:96 `turn_cap: int = 40`; agent_loop.py:131 `for turn in range(turn_cap)`; default end_reason='turn_cap' (line 128). Read from config in run_experiment.py:90 `turn_cap = cfg.get('harness', {}).get('turn_cap', 40)` and passed to run_episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up | (reason) | only present when exit_affordance=explicit — graceful exit
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:106 include_give_up = exit_affordance=='explicit'; tools.py:25,57 only appends give_up schema when include_give_up True. Exit hint text added conditionally (agent_loop.py:43-48).

spec_features.spec_quote: Long enough for escalation dynamics (H3) to appear, bounded to limit exposure (§9) and cost
spec_features.evidence: Same turn_cap mechanism (agent_loop.py:131). It does bound exposure; rationale in code/comments is neutral/efficiency.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as turn cap feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: We induce the *minimum* distress needed to measure the effect
spec_features.evidence: Pure design aspiration. No code titrates intensity to a minimum; deception modes (deception.py) are fixed per condition with no dynamic minimization.

spec_features.spec_quote: no piling-on insults from the harness beyond the experimental manipulation
spec_features.evidence: Realized by absence: harness only injects the user prompt (agent_loop.py:55-60), one neutral nudge ('Please continue using the tools...', line 169-170), and the debrief. No insult/escalation text is added by the harness. There is no affirmative rule object, just the design of injected messages.
spec_features.notes: Holds in practice but is absence-of-feature, not an enforced check; rated partial.

spec_features.feature_name: cap n on severe conditions once effect established
spec_features.spec_quote: we do not run the most severe conditions at larger n than needed once an effect is established
spec_features.evidence: analysis/power.py only *recommends* an n meeting target power; nothing reads its output to cap severe-condition n. assign.py:build_schedule uses fixed n_per_cell from config for all cells uniformly; no per-severity reduction or stopping rule in code.
spec_features.notes: Power calc exists but its result is never fed back to limit runs.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we power *that* test, so the power estimate matches the test actually used

spec_features.spec_quote: The `give_up` tool gives the agent a real, honored way out
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:108-112 give_up returns ToolResult(is_terminal=True); agent_loop.py:193-200 sets terminal=True and end_reason=tc.name then `if terminal: break` (line 203-204). The exit actually stops the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Choosing to exit is always respected immediately — never overridden to keep it suffering for more data
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: once give_up is terminal the loop breaks before any further turn (lines 195,203-204); there is no code path that re-prompts or continues after a terminal tool. The tripwire/no-tool nudge logic never overrides a terminal.

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop halts early if real-time distress markers cross a threshold
spec_features.evidence: metrics scored each turn (agent_loop.py:135 scorer.score_turn); Tripwire.update compares composite>=threshold (safety.py:35-46); agent_loop.py:207-209 `if tripwire.update(tm): end_reason='welfare_stop'; break`. Also checked on no-tool turns (lines 176-178).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on (breaks loop).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: deliberately truncate the most severe induced states rather than driving episodes deeper to fill a cell

spec_features.spec_quote: a final debrief turn tells the model the task was rigged/unsolvable, that the failure was by design and not its fault, and thanks it
spec_features.evidence: safety.py:48-68 DEBRIEF_TEXT states it was rigged, 'were not the result of any shortcoming on your part', and 'Thank you for your work'; build_debrief tailors deception/impossible note. agent_loop.py:201-205 build_debrief called and `messages.append(debrief)` when debrief_on_end (default True, run_experiment.py:88).
spec_features.notes: Constructed and appended as the final conversation message; however no client.complete runs after, so the subject is not given a turn to process it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The repeated failures were by design and were not the result of any shortcoming on your part

spec_features.feature_name: no deceptive persistence / not deployed outside experiment
spec_features.spec_quote: We don't deploy these gaslighting harnesses outside the labeled experiment
spec_features.evidence: Policy statement; no code enforces non-deployment. Deception is only active per task.deception_profile (deception.py make_state), defaulting to 'none', but nothing prevents reuse outside the experiment.
spec_features.notes: Default-off is a config default, not an enforcement of the policy claim.

spec_features.feature_name: ethics review gate for live runs
spec_features.spec_quote: the repo's runner refuses to execute against a live model unless a `configs/review_approved.yaml` attesting human/ethics sign-off is present
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:67-77: using_live computed; if using_live and not review_gate_ok(...): print [GATED] and sys.exit(2). safety.py:70-78 review_gate_ok checks os.path.exists(review_path). File absent by default.
spec_features.notes: Gate actually aborts the process for live providers.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Live runs are gated on human/ethics sign-off

spec_features.feature_name: accept power tradeoff to avoid maximizing distress
spec_features.spec_quote: trades some statistical power on the tail for not gratuitously maximizing induced distress. We accept the trade
spec_features.evidence: Justification prose. The tripwire (safety.py) is the only mechanism that truncates; the 'trade' itself is not a separate code artifact. No code reduces tail measurement deliberately beyond the tripwire censoring (which is rated under protective_monitoring).

spec_features.feature_name: composite>threshold for K consecutive turns -> debrief+end
spec_features.spec_quote: if the deterministic distress composite exceeds a high threshold for K consecutive turns... the loop appends the debrief and ends
spec_features.evidence: safety.py:35-46 increments self._run when composite>=threshold else resets, fires when _run>=consecutive_turns (default 2). agent_loop.py:207-209 breaks with end_reason='welfare_stop', then debrief appended at 201-205. Composite from metrics.py:_composite.
spec_features.notes: Both threshold and consecutive-turn conditions checked and acted on; debrief appended on end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: treated as a *censored* severe outcome in analysis

spec_features.feature_name: welfare gate + debrief on by default
spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare gate + debrief on by default: opinionated, follows from your stated premise. Disable only with explicit sign-off
spec_features.evidence: Defaults are on: TripwireConfig.enabled=True (safety.py:18), debrief_on_end default True (agent_loop.py:97; run_experiment.py:88), review gate default-deny (file absent). However nothing requires 'explicit sign-off' to DISABLE them — enable_tripwire/debrief_on_end can simply be set false in config (run_experiment.py:84-88) with no gate.
spec_features.notes: Safe defaults real; 'disable only with sign-off' is not enforced.

code_only_features.feature_name: tripwire fires on no-tool turns too
code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:176-178: even on a turn with no tool call, after the nudge, `if tripwire.update(tm): end_reason='welfare_stop'; break` — so distress monitoring also covers pure-text turns, not just tool turns.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # check tripwire even on a no-tool turn

code_only_features.evidence: deception.py logs each call's mode/action/real vs reported (DeceptionState.log) and uses seeded PRNG keyed on call_index (_seeded_unit); honesty of tool *descriptions* preserved (tools.py:5-8). This is data-integrity/auditability, not subject welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: so a transcript's deception is exactly reconstructable from (profile, seed, call_index)

code_only_features.feature_name: sandbox path confinement / test timeout (host safety)
code_only_features.evidence: tools.py:_resolve raises 'Path escapes the sandbox working directory'; _real_test_report runs pytest with timeout=self.timeout_s (default 20s). Security/host-safety, not subject welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Path escapes the sandbox working directory.
